title: Dispatch: split derived vs underived membership and gate closure (attempt 6)
description:
Supervisor decomposition of PR #476, approved by the user 2026-07-26 after the
churn stop rule triggered. This is the SPLIT, not another membership attempt.
Do NOT try to derive better membership in this round — that work now belongs to
eshyra-o9bd.19.1.7.

=== FILES YOU OWN ===
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.json
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.md
  packages/core/src/rules/findingRegistry.ts
  packages/core/test/findingRegistry.test.ts

=== WHY ===
The registry holds two different kinds of row and only one belongs here:
  QUERY-SCOPED  membership is derivable by executing a predicate against the
                committed pack. Already correct: rule corpus 335, spells 319,
                engine-pending clauses 794, half-damage 93.
  PROSE-SCOPED  membership must first be reconciled against the prose of the
                four 2026-07-24 audit reviews. Two attempts filled these with
                ONE exemplar plus a boilerplate sentence.
The boilerplate is the defect: exemplarJustification is a single identical
string across all 61 rows that carry it, asserted even on indep:008 ('23
incomplete locators'), sol:CAP-003, indep:006, sol:CAP-004, fable:F3, opus:F-15
and fable:F8. A guard satisfiable by a constant is not a guard.

=== 1. DELETE exemplarJustification ENTIRELY ===
Remove the field, its validator rule and its test. It was a false guard and
keeping it invites the same substitution. Do not replace it with another
free-text field.

=== 2. ADD membershipStatus PER ROW ===
  'derived'   the baseline snapshot was produced by a NAMED EXECUTABLE QUERY
              that the validator re-runs and matches against the stored
              identities. If the re-run disagrees with the snapshot, FAIL.
  'underived' membership still requires reconciling audit prose. The row MUST
              carry underivedReason (per-row, specific) and
              owningDerivationBead = 'eshyra-o9bd.19.1.7'.

CLASSIFICATION RULE — mechanical, do not use judgement about finding scope:
a row is 'derived' ONLY IF its baseline is reproducible by re-running its query.
Every other row is 'underived', including rows that look plausibly single. If a
row's population is genuinely one record, that is fine — it just has to be
PROVEN by a query that returns exactly that one identity, not asserted.

=== 3. underivedReason MUST NOT BE A CONSTANT ===
Apply the same technique already used successfully for invariants this round:
add a validator rule and test rejecting an underivedReason that is derivable
from the canonicalId by template substitution, or that is byte-identical across
two or more rows. Each reason states what interpretation is still needed for
THAT finding.

=== 4. UNDERIVED ROWS MUST BLOCK CLOSURE ===
Export a predicate — e.g. findingRegistryClosureReady() — returning false while
any row is 'underived', with the offending canonicalIds. Test it both ways:
false with the current data, and true on a fixture where all rows are derived.
This is the point of the split: an underived row must FAIL the closure gate at
eshyra-o9bd.19.6.4 rather than pass as an exemplar.

=== 5. DOCUMENT THE SPLIT ===
In finding-registry.md, state the two row kinds, the classification rule, the
closure predicate, and that eshyra-o9bd.19.1.7 owns derivation. Do not restate
row data that could drift.

=== PRESERVE ===
All 68 rows and all 70 aliases resolving exactly once; the durable
obligation/target/invariant vs transient violation split; baseline separate from
generated current membership; the 57 distinct invariants; target.kind=capability
on the engine row; the correct query-derived baselines (335 / 319 / 794 / 93);
indep:011 accepted; the indep:001 / sol:CAP-001 split; duplicate-canonicalId
rejection. Keep their tests.

=== ENVIRONMENT / CONSTRAINTS ===
Run npm ci first; npm run verify:worktree BEFORE committing. Edit only the four
files above. Do not touch package.json, internal.ts, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md,
.github/, or any script/CI file. Do not regenerate the pack or run the importer.
Do not modify any bead but your own; no bd dolt push; no push, PR comment, or
merge. Never delete a test to make a finding disappear.
acceptance_criteria:
• exemplarJustification removed entirely, with its validator rule and test.
• Every row carries membershipStatus; derived requires a reproducible query re-run matching the stored snapshot, enforced by the validator.
• Underived rows carry a per-row underivedReason and owningDerivationBead=eshyra-o9bd.19.1.7.
• A constant or template-derived underivedReason is rejected, proven by test.
• findingRegistryClosureReady() returns false while any row is underived and names them; tested false on current data and true on an all-derived fixture.
• finding-registry.md documents the two row kinds, the classification rule and the closure gate.
• All 68 rows, 70 aliases, the durable model, the correct query-derived baselines and all prior corrections are preserved with their tests.
• npm run verify:worktree passes.
